gates.detail: Dedicated wallet identity, funded mainnet balances, classic USDC ATA, and SOL reserve passed the real non-broadcast validation command.
Fresh two-hop state, exact bigint quote, compiled-message inspection, strict freshness, packet-size, unsigned and signed mainnet simulation are implemented.
The external dedicated keypair was matched to BOT_WALLET_ADDRESS during funded mainnet validation; secret bytes are neither logged nor stored in environment variables.
The real v0 Orca two-hop message passed unsigned sigVerify=false and locally signed sigVerify=true mainnet simulation.
The executor no longer imports @solana/spl-token; account/mint validation uses RPC jsonParsed responses and Token-2022 execution is fail-closed.

Execution-critical modules do not import scanner provider implementations, @solana/spl-token, or bigint-buffer. The reviewed aggregator executor has independent minimal HTTP clients and accepts only a strict instruction-free handoff DTO.
Read-only confirmation detects failure, retrieves on-chain balances/fee, calculates realized P&L and dust, and persists accounting in the execution journal.
Fail-closed legal state transitions are atomically persisted. Any unresolved SUBMITTING/SUBMITTED/CONFIRMING record must be reconciled before a new submission.

The Orca handoff validator treats DTO economics as untrusted, fetches fresh state, rebuilds/re-inspects/re-simulates, enforces conservative minimum-output profit/ROI and blockhash validity, then stops at APPROVED_FOR_SUBMISSION.

Distinct Orca Whirlpool combinations are screened and exact-quoted at 0.01/0.02/0.05 USDC. Core and eligible HOT/WARM classic-SPL intermediate mints may produce the strict DTO; the executor independently rechecks mint policy and economics.

Raptor/Jupiter and Jupiter-or-Raptor with direct Orca raw instructions are independently rebuilt for constrained complete cycles. Dynamic classic-SPL intermediates must pass mint/freeze policy; ALTs and compiled messages are independently verified.
Scanner-only bigint-buffer remains isolated. Executor-reachable jayson calls uuid.v4() without external buffers; the v3/v5/v6 buffer advisory is not reachable. See docs/dependency-security-audit.md.
The one-shot broadcaster accepts only in-process branded ApprovedSignedExecution bytes, persists signature/hash before one maxRetries=0 RPC call, and never retries ambiguity.
